ja282:1.1: Seyyaṃso seyyaso hoti yo seyyam upasevati, ekena sandhiṃ katvāna sataṃ vajjhe amocayiṃ.
ja282:2.1: Tasmā sabbena lokena sandhiṃ katvāna ekako pecca saggaṃ na gaccheyya, idaṃ suṇotha Kāsayo
ja282:3.1: ti. Idaṃ vatvā mahārājā Kaṃso Bārāṇasiggaho dhanuṃ tūṇiñ ca nikkhippa saññamam ajjhupāgamīti.
